integrity: Exact word algebra proves the quantified statement; rational-arithmetic checks sample only finite word lengths. Earliest cited source introduced the original model, while the generalized family dates to 2022. No independent verification or publication-priority guarantee is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The fixed return iterate need not be primitive; regularity holds on cylinder interiors only; density is proved in two dimensions; the sharpness claim concerns center-only resolution, not joint base/center bounds.
title: Quantitative density and sharp center resolution of neutral periodic fibers in heterochaos baker maps
